CVE-2026-111497.description:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.





Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

CVE-2026-93841.description: vLLM through 0.29.0 contains a memory corruption vulnerability in the Triton _bincount_kernel where prompt token IDs index the penalty prompt-presence bitset without bounds checking against vocabulary size. Attackers can submit multimodal audio requests with tokens equal to vocabulary size, causing out-of-bounds writes that corrupt concurrent requests' sampler state and alter repetition penalty behavior.

posts.content: CVE-2026-9613: auth bypass in Datalogics WordPress plugin (up to 2.6.65) lets subscribers create or cancel real shipping orders via the stored API token. CVSS 4.3, no patch confirmed. Update or disable the plugin now. #CVE #infosec #WordPress https://www.valtersit.com/cve/CVE-2026-9613/

CVE-2026-9613.description: The Datalogics Ecommerce Delivery – Datalogics plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.6.65. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to create and cancel real shipping orders through the external logistics API using the store's stored authentication token, modify arbitrary WooCommerce order post meta on any order, overwrite the plugin's stored API token, and trigger shipping notification emails to customers.

CVE-2026-124480.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read cross-patient FHIR QuestionnaireResponse data by sending the APICSRFTOKEN header. Attackers can reuse the session-exposed api_csrf_token_js value to skip FHIR scope checks and call GET /fhir/QuestionnaireResponse, exfiltrating site-wide questionnaire answer PHI.

posts.content:
SonicWall Reports Critical Vulnerabilities in End-of-Life Global Management System, Will NOT be Fixed

SonicWall reports two vulnerabilities in its End-of-Life Global Management System (GMS), including a critical unauthenticated file read flaw (CVE-2026-109593).

**If you are still running SonicWall GMS 9.5.2 or older, you must migrate to Network Security Manager immediately because these flaws will never be patched. Until you can migrate, pull the GMS server behind a strict VPN and disconnect it from the public internet to prevent remote file theft.**
#cybersecurity #infosec #advisory #vulnerability

posts.content: CVE-2026-9766: Empik for WooCommerce plugin authorization bypass lets subscriber-level users modify arbitrary product metadata. CVSS 4.3, no patch confirmed. Update the plugin or restrict access now. #CVE #infosec #WordPress https://www.valtersit.com/cve/CVE-2026-9766/

CVE-2026-9766.description: The Empik for Woocommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.1. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to modify arbitrary WooCommerce product metadata, including Empik logistic class (_empik_logistic_klass), product state (_empik_product_state, _empik_product_state_all_variants), and Empik export and offer flags on any product in the store.
